blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Hi Dwayne! Let's fix the dosage first.…
blocks_element.text:
Hi Dwayne! Let's fix the dosage first. A full cap is actually 3 servings, the correct amount is 1 tablespoon (15ml), which equals half a cap only. Taking a full cap means you've been tripling the recommended dose.
Also, keep in mind sweating isn't really a true measure of whether it's working. The thermogenic effect raises body temp for about 2 hours, but heavy sweating mostly shows up when you're active or exercising, not just sitting at rest.
My suggestion: scale back to half a cap (1 tablespoon) in the morning on an empty stomach, and take your second shot 4-6 hours later if you want continued fat-burning support throughout the day. No need to double up on a full cap, that's already way more than intended and could cause stomach discomfort.
Stay consistent with the correct dose and your nutrition and training, and you'll feel the difference.
